description: Ministry of Labour - The Industrial disputes between Haycarb PLC (Badalgama) No. 400, Colombo 10 and other Part Company Employees Union No. 259/9 Koswatta, Talangama (E Only)
categorisation: This gazette content publishes a Collective Agreement between a private company (Haycarb PLC) and a trade union under the Industrial Disputes Act. It contains detailed regulatory terms and conditions of employment, including salary revisions, bonuses, allowances, and dispute resolution procedures. This falls under legal/regulatory matters as it constitutes subsidiary legislation and regulatory frameworks governing employment relationships, published pursuant to statutory authority.
